family.description: This entry represents the C-terminal alpha helical bundle domain. The eukaryotic GINS complex is essential for the initiation and elongation phases of DNA replication [[cite:PUB00012381],[cite:PUB00015004],[cite:PUB00152224]]. It consists of four paralogous protein subunits (Sld5, Psf1, Psf2 and Psf3), all of which are included in this family. The GINS complex is conserved from yeast to humans, and has been shown in human to bind directly to DNA primase [[cite:PUB00109209]].
family.name: GINS complex protein helical bundle domain
